correctness.rationale: Lucas parity equates the row support with binary submasks. For one-runs separated by a zero, the total contribution from lower blocks, even when all pairwise sum-digits vary, is strictly less than the unit of the next block, proving injectivity and exact product convolution. Summed squared triangular block counts equal (2m^3+m)/3. Formal initial-run decomposition gives F=(1+W)/(1-z-zW) and the stated rational form. The standalone exact-convolution/aggregate verifier passed its finite cross-checks, but infinity follows from these proofs.
